title: Kinetic Insights from Operando Synchrotron X-ray Microscopy Analysis of Energy Materials at Elevated Temperatures
content: Our presentation explores energy materials operating at elevated temperature (∼500-900°C), focusing on thermochemical materials for long-duration storage and materials interfacing with molten salts for advanced nuclear and solar power applications. These materials can experience significant morphological, chemical, and structural transformations due to elevated temperatures and complex environments. Employing a multimodal synchrotron approach, our study integrates in situ nano-tomography with spectroscopic imaging, complemented by bulk scattering and spectroscopy techniques.
